_comment: How rtc-ship.sh ships THIS repo. Data lives here; commands live in .rtc/. A repo with no .rtc/ directory is fully supported — hooks are opt-in by presence.
_comment_tests: No pytest suite here: the tests are shell suites, so the gate runs them via a declared test_cmd, in parallel (GNU parallel exits with the number of failed jobs; 42s serial -> 32s, 2026-10-28). An UNCOLLECTED suite is a failure, never a pass.
